The Property

Where History
Meets Modern Comfort

Refurbished in 2023 and ideally situated between Keswick, Carlisle and Penrith, The Rockery sits in the village of Shap — known locally as the 'Gateway to the Fells and Lakes' — on the eastern edge of the Lake District National Park, just minutes from Ullswater, the second largest lake in the Lake District.

Perfect for large families and groups of friends, the property sleeps up to 10 and can be booked alongside Primrose Cottage (UK1039) to accommodate up to 12 guests. Gas central heating, electricity, bed linen, towels, Wi-Fi, logs for the wood burner, a travel cot, highchair, and a welcome pack are all included.

"Customers' Choice Award winner 2021, 2023, 2024 & 2025 — one of the most-loved holiday lets in Cumbria."

Where to Find Us

Shap Village,
Cumbria

Shap is known locally as the 'Gateway to the Fells and Lakes' — sitting on the eastern edge of the Lake District National Park, close to Ullswater, the second largest lake in the Lake District. The village itself offers a pub, shops, and restaurant just 200 yards away, plus a public outdoor heated swimming pool, children's play area, and tennis courts.

The Eden Valley provides superb walking and cycling, while Haweswater (8 miles) offers a viewpoint for golden eagles. Bustling market towns, farmers' markets, and county shows abound, with excellent local produce and regional favourites in the many pubs and restaurants nearby.

Historic Carlisle with its castle is easily accessible, Hadrian's Wall (a World Heritage Site) is within reach, and both the Northumberland National Park and southern Scotland are under an hour's drive.
